$comment: Stanbic Bank — GHAS custom secret scanning patterns. Apply at Organization > Settings > Code security > Secret scanning > Custom patterns. Push protection should be enabled for each pattern after dry-run validation. This file is the source-of-truth definition used by the security team.
name: Stanbic Internal Secret Patterns

patterns.name: Stanbic Live API Token
patterns.description: Production API tokens issued by the Stanbic Integration Gateway. Format: STB_LIVE_ followed by 32 alphanumeric characters. Detection blocks the push (push protection) and raises a secret scanning alert.
patterns.test_string_note: For live demos, generate a fake token matching the pattern at demo time; never commit a matching string to this repository.

patterns.name: Stanbic Sandbox API Token
patterns.description: Sandbox tokens — alert only (no push protection) to demonstrate severity tiering.

patterns.name: Stanbic Treasury Rates API Key
patterns.description: Keys for the internal Treasury Rates feed used by the FX quote engine.

patterns.name: Stanbic Core Ledger Connection String
patterns.description: JDBC/ODBC connection strings pointing at the core ledger cluster.

steps: 1. Create each pattern via org settings and run a dry run across all repositories.
2. Review dry-run matches with the security team; tune before/after boundaries.
3. Publish the pattern, then enable push protection per pattern.
4. Configure alert routing to the #sec-secret-alerts channel and the SIEM webhook.
